checklist.step: Inventory every procedure the Insurance Companies Act requires
actions: In the GRC platform's policy library, list every procedure covering an ICA-governed area: the Investment Policy (ss. 492-495, Investment Limits Regulations), the Capital and Liquidity Adequacy Procedure (s. 515(1)), and licensing/appointment conduct procedures.
For each, record the owning role, the governing citation and the current approval date.
Confirm with the Chief Investment Officer and Head of Capital Management that no in-scope procedure is missing from the inventory.
Save the inventory as the procedures register.
checklist.done: every ICA-governed procedure is listed with owner, citation and current approval date in the register.

checklist.step: Draft or update each procedure against the current regulatory text
actions: Re-read the current text of ss. 492-495, the Investment Limits (Insurance Companies) Regulations, and s. 515(1).
Compare each provision's requirement against the corresponding procedure's content, clause by clause.
Draft redlines for any provision not fully reflected, including the aggregate limits on real property, equities and commercial loans relative to total assets.
Route redlines to the procedure owner for business input before finalizing.
checklist.done: each procedure's redline is complete and reflects every current provision of the cited sections and regulations.

checklist.step: Route procedures through the formal approval workflow
actions: Submit each finalized procedure through the GRC platform's approval workflow to the Chief Risk Officer and Board Governance Lead.
Attach the redline and a summary of what changed from the prior version.
Track the workflow to a recorded approval decision and date.
Publish the approved version to the live library and archive the prior version.
checklist.done: every procedure carries a recorded approval decision, date and an archived prior version.

checklist.step: Maintain the Investment Policy prudent-person standard content
actions: Confirm the Investment Policy states the prudent-person standard and the current aggregate limits on real property, equities and commercial loans as a percentage of total assets per the Investment Limits Regulations.
Cross-check the policy's stated limits against the current regulation text for any recent amendment.
Confirm the policy names the monitoring cadence and the escalation path for a breach of any limit.
Sign off the content before it is routed for formal approval.
checklist.done: the Investment Policy's prudent-person and aggregate-limit content matches the current regulation and carries the CIO's content sign-off.

checklist.step: Maintain the Capital and Liquidity Adequacy Procedure content
actions: Confirm the procedure describes the ongoing assessment of capital and liquidity adequacy required under s. 515(1), including the monitoring metrics and internal target ranges.
Cross-check the procedure against the current OSFI capital guideline for any target or methodology change.
Confirm the procedure names the escalation path for a target breach, up to and including notification obligations.
Sign off the content before it is routed for formal approval.
checklist.done: the Capital and Liquidity Adequacy Procedure reflects current OSFI guidance and carries the Capital Management Manager's content sign-off.

checklist.step: Maintain the licensing/appointment conduct procedures
actions: Confirm the licensing/appointment procedures (verification, appointment/termination processing, renewal/CE tracking, 1033 screening, roster reconciliation) remain consistent with current NIPR data specifications and state statutes.
Cross-reference each procedure to its item-level owning role in the procedures register.
Confirm the procedures name the escalation path for a licensing control gap.
Sign off the content before it is routed for formal approval.
checklist.done: the licensing/appointment procedures are current and carry the Producer Compliance Manager's content sign-off.

checklist.step: Schedule and track the 12-month review window per procedure
actions: Set each procedure's next-review date to 12 months from its last approval date in the GRC platform.
Configure the T-11-month alert to the procedure owner and a weekly escalation alert for any procedure past its 12-month mark.
Review the at-risk report monthly for procedures inside their review window with no update in progress.
Escalate any at-risk procedure to the Chief Risk Officer.
checklist.done: every procedure has a tracked 12-month review window with active alerts and monthly at-risk monitoring.

checklist.step: Confirm operational practice matches the documented procedure
actions: Select a sample of recent investment transactions, capital adequacy assessments, or licensing actions and compare the actual practice to the current documented procedure.
Note any practice that has drifted from the documented steps (e.g. a limit monitored differently than described).
Route drift findings to the procedure owner for either a procedure update or a practice correction.
Record the review outcome.
checklist.done: operational practice is spot-checked against the documented procedure with drift findings routed for correction.

checklist.step: Update procedures on any OSFI guideline or regulation amendment
actions: Monitor OSFI guideline releases and Canada Gazette amendments to the Insurance Companies Act and the Investment Limits Regulations.
On any relevant change, open an off-cycle update to the affected procedure rather than waiting for the annual review.
Route the off-cycle update through the same approval workflow.
Notify all affected procedure owners of the effective date.
checklist.done: every relevant regulatory change triggers an off-cycle procedure update approved before the change's effective date.

checklist.step: Retire and archive superseded procedure versions
actions: On approval of a new version, move the superseded version into the compliance evidence repository with a 'Superseded' label and the supersession date.
Apply the 7-year-from-supersession retention label.
Confirm the live library shows only the current approved version.
Confirm the repository record links the superseded version to its replacement.
checklist.done: every superseded version is archived, labelled and linked to its replacement in the repository.

checklist.step: Log exceptions for lapsed reviews or drifted practice
actions: Raise a tracker issue for every procedure past its 12-month review window without an approved extension.
Raise a tracker issue for every confirmed practice-drift finding from the internal audit spot check.
Assign root cause and a named owner for each.
Set a remediation date and carry open issues into the next annual test as mandatory retest items.
checklist.done: every lapsed review or drift finding has a tracker issue with root cause, owner, remediation date and retest status.

checklist.step: Retain the current approval evidence for every procedure
actions: Confirm the current approved version, its redline history and approval workflow record are filed together in the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the 7-year retention label from the date it is superseded.
Confirm the repository index is searchable by procedure name and citation.
checklist.done: current approval evidence for every procedure is filed, labelled and searchable by name and citation.

checklist.step: Communicate approved procedure updates to affected staff
actions: On publication of an approved new or updated procedure, issue a bulletin to every role named as an owner or user in the procedures register.
Attach a summary of what changed and the effective date.
Track read/acknowledgement completion in the GRC platform's training/attestation module.
Escalate to the role's manager any staff member who has not acknowledged within 10 business days.
checklist.done: every approved procedure update is communicated to affected staff with tracked acknowledgement within 10 business days.

checklist.step: Report procedures-governance status to the board
actions: Present the annual procedures-governance summary — inventory count, on-time review rate and open exceptions — to the board via the board portal.
Highlight any procedure lapsed past its review window.
Record board feedback and any directed action.
File the presentation with the board minutes.
checklist.done: the board has reviewed and recorded the annual procedures-governance summary and any open exceptions.

checklist.step: Confirm regulator-readiness of the procedure library
actions: Export the full procedure library with version, approval date and next-review date.
Confirm the export can be produced within 5 business days of a simulated OSFI request.
Store the export template so a real request can be answered without rebuilding it.
Log the readiness check date.
checklist.done: a regulator-ready procedure library export is confirmed producible within 5 business days and its template is stored.

testing.step: Build the population of in-scope procedures
actions: Export the full procedures register from the GRC platform with owner, citation, last approval date and next-review date.
Reconcile the export to the list of ICA-governed areas identified at the start of the test (investment, capital adequacy, licensing/appointment conduct).
Resolve any procedure missing from the export before sampling.
testing.done: the population of in-scope procedures is reconciled to the identified ICA-governed areas and signed as complete.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the method
actions: Take 100% of procedures past their 12-month review window as of the test date.
Take a random sample of 5 additional current procedures, seeded and reproducible.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible and covers every lapsed-review procedure.

testing.step: Re-verify each sampled procedure's content against current regulatory text
actions: Independently re-read the current text of the cited sections and regulations for each sampled procedure.
Compare the procedure's content clause by clause to the current text, without relying on the prior redline.
Log as an exception any provision not reflected in the procedure.
testing.done: each sampled procedure's content is independently compared to current regulatory text with any gap logged.

testing.step: Verify the approval chain for each sampled procedure
actions: Pull the workflow history for each sampled procedure's current version.
Confirm both the Chief Risk Officer and Board Governance Lead approvals are present and dated.
Log as an exception any procedure live in the library without both required approvals.
testing.done: the approval chain is independently confirmed complete for every sampled procedure.

testing.step: Recompute the review-window compliance rate
actions: Using the full population export, independently recompute the percentage of procedures within their 12-month review window.
Compare to the rate reported by the Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager; investigate any difference.
Confirm the count of lapsed procedures matches the exceptions log.
testing.done: the review-window compliance rate is independently recomputed and reconciles to the reported rate.

testing.step: Test operational practice against the sampled procedures
actions: For the Investment Policy sample, pull a recent investment transaction and confirm it was assessed against the documented aggregate limits.
For the Capital and Liquidity Adequacy Procedure sample, pull the most recent capital adequacy assessment and confirm it followed the documented monitoring cadence and metrics.
Log any practice inconsistent with the documented procedure as an exception.
testing.done: operational practice is independently tested against each sampled procedure with any inconsistency logged.

testing.step: Verify archival and version control for superseded versions
actions: For each sampled procedure with a version history, confirm the superseded version is archived in the compliance evidence repository with the correct supersession date and retention label.
Confirm the live library shows only the current approved version, not a superseded one.
Log any missing archive or duplicate live version as an exception.
testing.done: archival and version control are independently confirmed correct for every sampled procedure.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with procedure name, citation and the gap identified.
Assign root cause and an owner distinct from the procedure's original author.
Set a remediation date and confirm the procedure update or approval-chain fix is scheduled.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Independent reviewer sign-off
actions: Confirm the reviewer authored or approved none of the sampled procedures.
Review the population, sample, re-performance notes and exception log for completeness.
Sign and date the workpaper.
testing.done: a reviewer independent of the sample has signed and dated the workpaper.

testing.step: Conclude, report and file
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-tolerance threshold for lapsed reviews.
Write the conclusion with evidence references.
Report to the board and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and exception rate is reported to the board and filed.
